+import django
+from django.conf import settings
+
+if not settings.configured:
+    settings.configure(
+        INSTALLED_APPS=[],
+        DATABASES={
+            "default": {
+                "ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3",
+                "NAME": ":memory:",
+            }
+        },
+    )
+
+django.setup()
+
+from django.db import models
+from django.forms.models import model_to_dict
+
+
+class ReproduceModel(models.Model):
+    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
+
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = "reproduce"
+
+
+instance = ReproduceModel(name="example")
+
+# An explicitly empty field list requests no fields.
+assert model_to_dict(instance, fields=[]) == {}, (
+    "model_to_dict(instance, fields=[]) should return an empty dict, got %r"
+    % (model_to_dict(instance, fields=[]),)
+)
+
+# Normal filtering behavior must remain intact.
+assert model_to_dict(instance, fields=["name"]) == {"name": "example"}
+assert model_to_dict(instance, fields=None)["name"] == "example"
